description: Removes an identified empty place from the selected wedding and its property order, and returns the order that remains. The places list supplies its id. This removes any recommendation or booking link on that place. Any rooms, including archived history, prevent removal. No rooms or payments are deleted. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

place_id.description: Identifier of the empty property to remove, from the selected wedding’s places list.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: remove_my_place
title: Remove Empty Place
